dialogues.jp: 電話が鳴った。
dialogues.en: "I think it's today."
dialogues.text: "I think it's today."

dialogues.jp: 「おーい、音夢ー。音夢、電話ー」
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei sounds very gloomy.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei sounds very gloomy.

dialogues.jp: 返事はない。
dialogues.en: "Today..."
dialogues.text: "Today..."

dialogues.jp: そうだった。音夢はもういないんだった。
dialogues.en:
"What a girl! She's been able to hold up until the end of
the semester."
dialogues.text:
"What a girl! She's been able to hold up until the end of
the semester."

dialogues.jp:
音夢は自分の夢を叶えるために、ついこの間、
島を出ていったんだ。
dialogues.en:
"She told me she'd try her best because she didn't want to
make anybody sad."
dialogues.text:
"She told me she'd try her best because she didn't want to
make anybody sad."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『おそらく、今日だと思う』
dialogues.en:
"Look, I could've kept my nose out of this, but I just
wanted you to know beforehand..."
dialogues.text:
"Look, I could've kept my nose out of this, but I just
wanted you to know beforehand..."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生にしては沈んだ声で、そう言った。
dialogues.en: "Thank you. It's better to know now. I can be ready."
dialogues.text: "Thank you. It's better to know now. I can be ready."

dialogues.jp: 「――今日ですか」
dialogues.en:
Miharu has been doing just fine in the past week since
graduation.
dialogues.text:
Miharu has been doing just fine in the past week since
graduation.

dialogues.jp: 卒業式から一週間経っても、美春は元気だった。
dialogues.en: Even yesterday she didn't show any sign of weakening.
dialogues.text: Even yesterday she didn't show any sign of weakening.

dialogues.jp: 昨日もそんな素振りはあまり見せなかったのに。
dialogues.en: Today...
dialogues.text: Today...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、今はＨＲだから、そんなに急ぐことはな
　いよ。落ち着いてから来ればいい」
dialogues.en: "No need to rush. I don't have any assigned class now."
dialogues.text: "No need to rush. I don't have any assigned class now."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『ＨＲって、先生は？』
dialogues.en: "No assigned class?"
dialogues.text: "No assigned class?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『あたしの受け持ちはみんな出てっちゃったか
　らね。のんびりしたもんだよ。昨日もＤＶＤ
　デッキを持ち込んじゃってさ』
dialogues.en:
"All of my students graduated. So I'm just relaxing. I even
brought a DVD player into my room yesterday."
dialogues.text:
"All of my students graduated. So I'm just relaxing. I even
brought a DVD player into my room yesterday."

dialogues.jp: 受話器の向こうで、クスクスと笑う声がする。
dialogues.en: I hear Koyomi-sensei giggling over the phone.
dialogues.text: I hear Koyomi-sensei giggling over the phone.

dialogues.jp:
「先生――考えたんですけど、美春のデータだ
　けを他の機体に移し替えることは出来ないん
　ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Sensei, I was just wondering if you could transfer Miharu's
data into another robot."
dialogues.text:
"Sensei, I was just wondering if you could transfer Miharu's
data into another robot."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『１回くらいは、そういうことを言ってくると
　思ってたけど、無理だよ、悪いけど』
dialogues.en:
"I knew you'd ask me that question, but the answer is no.
That's not possible."
dialogues.text:
"I knew you'd ask me that question, but the answer is no.
That's not possible."

dialogues.jp: 先生は笑うのをやめて、真面目な口調で答えた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei replies in a serious voice.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei replies in a serious voice.

dialogues.jp: 「なぜですか？」
dialogues.en: "Why not?"
dialogues.text: "Why not?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『現行機種が抱えている問題を解決しないまま、
　現行機種に移植しても意味ないだろ？』
dialogues.en:
"As long as the current model has a problem, transferring
data to the same model isn't going to change anything."
dialogues.text:
"As long as the current model has a problem, transferring
data to the same model isn't going to change anything."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『記憶だって、データを他の媒体に移せないの
　は人間だってロボットだって同じことだよ』
dialogues.en:
"Memories can't be transferred from one to another, whether
it is from a human or robot."
dialogues.text:
"Memories can't be transferred from one to another, whether
it is from a human or robot."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そんな……でも、いや、そうですよね。すみ
　ません、変なこと言っちゃって。できるなら
　とっくにやってますよね」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I see. Besides, I'm sure you would have done it already
if it was really possible. Sorry I asked you..."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I see. Besides, I'm sure you would have done it already
if it was really possible. Sorry I asked you..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『気持ちはわかる。気にすることはないさ』
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, I know how you feel."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, I know how you feel."

dialogues.jp:
アナログな音声が、俺の肩を叩いてくれてるよ
うな、そんな気がした。
dialogues.en: I felt as if her voice was patting me on the back.
dialogues.text: I felt as if her voice was patting me on the back.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『あのオルゴール。少し聴かせてもらったけど、
　いい曲だね。思い出の品なんだって？』
dialogues.en:
"By the way, I listened to that music box. That's a reminder
of your good old days, right?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, I listened to that music box. That's a reminder
of your good old days, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「俺が子供の頃『美春』に誕生日プレゼントに
　あげたらしいんですけど」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not sure, but it seems I gave it to 'Miharu' for her
birthday when we were still kids."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not sure, but it seems I gave it to 'Miharu' for her
birthday when we were still kids."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『覚えてないの？　あはは、朝倉もバカだねぇ。
　ま、子供の頃だから仕方ないのかもしれない
　けど』
dialogues.en: "You don't remember? Haha...Well, you were just a kid..."
dialogues.text: "You don't remember? Haha...Well, you were just a kid..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『あの子、ずっと聴いてるよ。よほど好きなん
　だね』
dialogues.en: "She keeps listening to it. She just loves that music."
dialogues.text: "She keeps listening to it. She just loves that music."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『ほら、そろそろ切るよ。待ってるから』
dialogues.en: "Okay, I got to go now. See you later."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I got to go now. See you later."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい、ありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 受話器から、プツリという音が聞こえた。
dialogues.en: I hear her hang up the phone.
dialogues.text: I hear her hang up the phone.

dialogues.jp:
美春との、約束を果たしにいこう。最期は一緒
にいるって約束したもんな。
dialogues.en:
I must keep our promise with her that I'll be with her
during the last moment of her life.
dialogues.text:
I must keep our promise with her that I'll be with her
during the last moment of her life.

dialogues.jp:
生物準備室の前まで来ると、オルゴールの音が
聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en:
I overheard the music box playing as I walked towards the
biology preparation room.
dialogues.text:
I overheard the music box playing as I walked towards the
biology preparation room.

dialogues.jp: 美春のオルゴールの音だ。
dialogues.en: That's Miharu's music box.
dialogues.text: That's Miharu's music box.

dialogues.jp:
扉に手をかける。この扉をくぐると現実が待っ
ている。
dialogues.en:
I open the door. The reality of it all waits for me beyond
this point.
dialogues.text:
I open the door. The reality of it all waits for me beyond
this point.

dialogues.jp: 「失礼します」
dialogues.en: "Hello."
dialogues.text: "Hello."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「やあ、朝倉。天枷も来てるよ」
dialogues.en: "Hi Asakura. Amakase's here."
dialogues.text: "Hi Asakura. Amakase's here."

dialogues.jp: 時間はお昼前。終業式とＨＲが終わった時間だ。
dialogues.en: It's right before lunch time.
dialogues.text: It's right before lunch time.

dialogues.en: "Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "Miharu..."

dialogues.jp:
オルゴールから流れる曲を、愛おしそうに聴く
美春。
dialogues.en:
Miharu's listening to the music that was playing out of her
music box.
dialogues.text:
Miharu's listening to the music that was playing out of her
music box.

dialogues.jp: 優しくて、透明感のある音色の曲だ。
dialogues.en: It's gentle and clear music.
dialogues.text: It's gentle and clear music.

dialogues.jp:
当時の俺は曲など聴かずに買ったんだろうけど、
こうして聞くと、いい曲を選んだものだと我な
がら感心する。
dialogues.en:
Back then I'm sure I just bought the music box without
listening to its music inside. But I feel I picked a nice
one.
dialogues.text:
Back then I'm sure I just bought the music box without
listening to its music inside. But I feel I picked a nice
one.

dialogues.jp: 「美春、調子はどうだ？」
dialogues.en: "How are you feeling, Miharu?"
dialogues.text: "How are you feeling, Miharu?"

dialogues.jp:
美春は何も答えず、ただただオルゴールに耳を
傾けている。
dialogues.en: Miharu doesn't respond, she just listens to the music.
dialogues.text: Miharu doesn't respond, she just listens to the music.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ダメだよ……。たぶん、聞こえていない」
dialogues.en: "No. She can't hear you..."
dialogues.text: "No. She can't hear you..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「聞こえていない？」
dialogues.en: "She can't hear me?"
dialogues.text: "She can't hear me?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「たぶん、今は色んな機能が制限されてるんだ
　と思う。結局、それだけ末期だということだ」
dialogues.en:
"She's only got limited functions left, which means -- she's
in a terminal state."
dialogues.text:
"She's only got limited functions left, which means -- she's
in a terminal state."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「正直言って、よく今日までもったと思ってる。
　データをチェックしたら、かなりずたずたに
　なっていたし」
dialogues.en:
"In fact, I'm amazed that she's managed to hold up this
long. Her data shows she is pretty messed up."
dialogues.text:
"In fact, I'm amazed that she's managed to hold up this
long. Her data shows she is pretty messed up."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そんなになるまで……」
dialogues.en: "My god..."
dialogues.text: "My god..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「優しい子だからね。――もし、このまま天枷
　が朝倉に気がつかないまま停止したとしても、
　許してやってくれ」
dialogues.en:
"Please forgive her if she has to stop without noticing
you."
dialogues.text:
"Please forgive her if she has to stop without noticing
you."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「許すも何も。あいつなりの頑張りを俺が認め
　てやらなくて、どうするんですか」
dialogues.en:
"Forgive her -- no way. I have no right to do that. She
deserves better."
dialogues.text:
"Forgive her -- no way. I have no right to do that. She
deserves better."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「俺は美春が今日まで頑張ってたことを知って
　るし、どれだけみんなのことを思いやってい
　たかを知ってますから」
dialogues.en:
"I know how hard she was trying and how much she cared about
her friends."
dialogues.text:
"I know how hard she was trying and how much she cared about
her friends."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Thank you, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
オルゴールの音がだんだん遅くなり、途切れそ
うになっていく。
dialogues.en: The music is getting slower and almost breaking off.
dialogues.text: The music is getting slower and almost breaking off.

dialogues.jp: 「美春……巻いてやるよ」
dialogues.en: "Let me wind it up for you, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Let me wind it up for you, Miharu."

dialogues.jp:
俺は美春の持っているねじ巻きで、オルゴール
のねじを巻き直してやった。
dialogues.en: I wind up the music box with the key Miharu had.
dialogues.text: I wind up the music box with the key Miharu had.

dialogues.jp: オルゴールがまた音楽を奏で始める。
dialogues.en: The music box starts to play again.
dialogues.text: The music box starts to play again.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「――朝倉先輩」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai..."

dialogues.jp: 美春が俺の名前を呼んだ。
dialogues.en: Miharu calls me.
dialogues.text: Miharu calls me.

dialogues.jp: 弱々しい、まるで今にも消え入りそうな声で。
dialogues.en: In a feeble voice.
dialogues.text: In a feeble voice.

dialogues.jp: 「美春、俺がわかるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Miharu, can you still recognize me?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu, can you still recognize me?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「当たり前じゃないですか。美春が先輩のこと
　がわからないわけないですよ」
dialogues.en: "Of course I do. How can I forget you, sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Of course I do. How can I forget you, sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そっか、そうだよな……うん、うん」
dialogues.en: "You're right... Right..."
dialogues.text: "You're right... Right..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩、美春に会いに来てくれてありがとうご
　ざいます。約束を守ってくれたんですね」
dialogues.en:
"Sempai, I'm so glad you came to see me. You kept our
promise."
dialogues.text:
"Sempai, I'm so glad you came to see me. You kept our
promise."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まだ、大丈夫だ、美春はまだ止まったりしな
　いよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry. You're not gonna stop yet."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry. You're not gonna stop yet."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「へへへ。自分の身体は自分が一番よく知って
　いますから」
dialogues.en: "Hehehe. I know what's going on inside of me."
dialogues.text: "Hehehe. I know what's going on inside of me."

dialogues.jp:
美春は、何のためらいも不安もなさげに、そう
言った。
dialogues.en: Miharu says with confidence.
dialogues.text: Miharu says with confidence.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春はこのオルゴールの曲をずっと聴いてい
　ました。いい曲ですよね……」
dialogues.en:
"I've been listening to this music. This is such beautiful
music."
dialogues.text:
"I've been listening to this music. This is such beautiful
music."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「聴いてると、先輩との色んなことを思い出す
　んです。先輩と街を歩いたり、公園でチョコ
　バナナを食べたりしたことを……」
dialogues.en:
"This music reminds me of all these things you and I did
together, like walking around town, eating chocolate
bananas, things like that."
dialogues.text:
"This music reminds me of all these things you and I did
together, like walking around town, eating chocolate
bananas, things like that."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩、ありがとうございました……。美春に
　思い出をたくさんくれて、本当にありがとう
　ございました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, sempai, for the wonderful memories."
dialogues.text: "Thank you, sempai, for the wonderful memories."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先生もありがとうございました。いっぱいご
　迷惑かけて、ごめんなさいでした」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you, Koyomi-sensei. And I'm sorry I gave you a lot of
trouble."
dialogues.text:
"Thank you, Koyomi-sensei. And I'm sorry I gave you a lot of
trouble."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩、美春は先輩に出会えて幸せでした。美
　春は先輩のこと、ずっと忘れません……」
dialogues.en: "I was so happy to meet you. I'll never forget about you..."
dialogues.text: "I was so happy to meet you. I'll never forget about you..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「俺だって、忘れないさ。美春のことはずっと
　忘れない」
dialogues.en: "I'll never ever forget about you, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "I'll never ever forget about you, Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「先輩、ありがとうございました……。美春は
　幸せでした……とっても幸せでした……」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, sempai. I've been happy... so happy."
dialogues.text: "Thank you, sempai. I've been happy... so happy."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春？」
dialogues.en: "Miharu?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu?"

dialogues.jp: 美春からはもう返事はなかった。
dialogues.en: There's no response from Miharu.
dialogues.text: There's no response from Miharu.

dialogues.en: "Miharu..."
dialogues.text: "Miharu..."

dialogues.jp:
美春の身体を揺すった。意識のない身体だけが
ぎこちなく揺れる。
dialogues.en: I shake her body, but it just moves awkwardly.
dialogues.text: I shake her body, but it just moves awkwardly.

dialogues.jp: 美春は動かなくなった。
dialogues.en: Miharu no longer moves.
dialogues.text: Miharu no longer moves.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ありがとう、朝倉。あたしは天枷の世話役に
　アンタを選んでよかったと思ってる」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you, Asakura. I'm glad I asked you to take care of
Amakase."
dialogues.text:
"Thank you, Asakura. I'm glad I asked you to take care of
Amakase."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「どんなことより、朝倉が天枷を幸せにしてく
　れたってことが、あたしは嬉しいよ」
dialogues.en:
"More than anything else, I'm glad that you made Amakase
happy."
dialogues.text:
"More than anything else, I'm glad that you made Amakase
happy."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉に感謝してる――」
dialogues.en: "I thank you for that..."
dialogues.text: "I thank you for that..."

dialogues.jp: なぜだか、涙が出なかった。
dialogues.en: I don't know why, but tears won't come out of my eyes.
dialogues.text: I don't know why, but tears won't come out of my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
覚悟していたからだろうか。美春がこうなって
しまうことを覚悟していたからだろうか。
dialogues.en: Is it because I was ready for it?
dialogues.text: Is it because I was ready for it?

dialogues.jp:
別れは遅かれ早かれやってくる、ということを
理解できているからだろうか。
dialogues.en:
Or is it because I understand that people can't stay with
their loved ones forever?
dialogues.text:
Or is it because I understand that people can't stay with
their loved ones forever?

dialogues.jp:
美春との思い出が、俺の胸の中にたくさんある
からだろうか。
dialogues.en:
Or is it because I have a lot of memories of Miharu memories
in my heart?
dialogues.text:
Or is it because I have a lot of memories of Miharu memories
in my heart?

dialogues.jp: ただ、涙は出なかった。
dialogues.en: I'm not crying.
dialogues.text: I'm not crying.

dialogues.jp: が、
dialogues.en: But...
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.jp:
「美春、ありがとう……。俺も幸せだったよ。
　美春に会えてよかったよ――」
dialogues.en:
"Miharu, thank you... I've been happy to meet you too,
Miharu."
dialogues.text:
"Miharu, thank you... I've been happy to meet you too,
Miharu."

dialogues.jp: とたんに｛せき／堰｝を切るように涙が溢れた。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, tears just begin to flow.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, tears just begin to flow.

dialogues.jp:
出ないわけがない。涙が出ないなんてこと、あ
るはずがなかった。
dialogues.en: How can I hold my tears back?
dialogues.text: How can I hold my tears back?

dialogues.jp: 目の前が涙でいっぱいになった。
dialogues.en: My eyes fill with tears.
dialogues.text: My eyes fill with tears.

dialogues.jp:
滝のように涙が溢れるということって本当にあ
るんだと、初めて知った。
dialogues.en:
For the first time in my life, tears flow down my cheeks
like a waterfall.
dialogues.text:
For the first time in my life, tears flow down my cheeks
like a waterfall.

dialogues.jp: 先生もいたけれど、関係なかった。
dialogues.en: I know Koyomi-sensei's in the room too, but...
dialogues.text: I know Koyomi-sensei's in the room too, but...

dialogues.jp: ただ、ただ、俺の目からは涙が流れ続けた。
dialogues.en: I just keep crying...
dialogues.text: I just keep crying...

dialogues.jp: ◆別れ◆
dialogues.en: ◆The phone rings.◆
dialogues.text: ◆The phone rings.◆

dialogues.jp:
美春の最後を知らせる、暦先生の電話を受けて
俺は学校に向かった。
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu, can you get the phone?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu, can you get the phone?"

dialogues.jp:
生物準備室に美春がいた。美春ただただオルゴー
ルに耳を傾けている。もう、ほとんどの機能が
制限されてるらしい。
dialogues.en: No response.
dialogues.text: No response.

dialogues.jp:
止まりかけたオルゴールを巻いてやると、美春
が俺に気づいた。
dialogues.en: Oh, I forgot. Nemu isn't here any more.
dialogues.text: Oh, I forgot. Nemu isn't here any more.

dialogues.jp: そして最後の会話。別れの言葉。
dialogues.en: Nemu already left the island in order to pursue her dream.
dialogues.text: Nemu already left the island in order to pursue her dream.

dialogues.speaker: 美春
dialogues.jp:
「先輩、ありがとうございました……。美春は
　幸せでした……とっても幸せでした……」
dialogues.en: I'm the only one living in this house.
dialogues.text: I'm the only one living in this house.

dialogues.jp: ただ、ただ、俺の目からは涙が流れ続けた。
dialogues.en: I walk down the stairs and pick up the phone.
dialogues.text: I walk down the stairs and pick up the phone.
